interface.shortDescription: Search INSPIRE-HEP papers, authors, experiments, HEPData records; get citation metrics and BibTeX.
interface.longDescription: High-energy physics literature from INSPIRE-HEP. Search papers with INSPIRE query syntax or free text, filtered by document type, subject, and year; read a paper's full record by recid, arXiv ID, or DOI, with authors and affiliations, abstract, identifiers, citation counts, and linked experiments; and export INSPIRE's BibTeX or LaTeX entries for any set of papers. Find physicist profiles by name, BAI, ORCID, or INSPIRE ID, and compute citation summaries (h-index, citation totals, papers per citation bucket, citations per year) for an author, a collaboration, or a topic. Look up experiments and collaborations such as ATLAS or DUNE, with their accelerators, institutions, and lifecycle dates. Find HEPData measurement records by process, observable, or energy through INSPIRE's index: each reports the record DOI, latest version, table count, and the hepdata.net page where the table values are read. A reference tool decodes the query syntax and filter vocabularies. No API key required; requests are paced under INSPIRE's limit of 15 per 5 seconds. INSPIRE metadata is mostly CC0 and HEPData tables are CC0; cite the HEPData record DOI when reusing its data.
